target.title: fix(plugins): wrap self-hosted discovery JSON parse in try/catch
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`readSelfHostedDiscoveryJson` parses HTTP response bodies from self-hosted provider discovery endpoints with `JSON.parse()` but without try/catch. A malformed JSON response from an untrusted third-party server crashes the provider setup flow with an uncaught SyntaxError.

## Why This Change Was Made

Wrap the `JSON.parse` call in try/catch and rethrow with a descriptive error message that identifies the failing endpoint label.

## User Impact

Malformed discovery responses now produce a readable error instead of crashing the gateway.

## Evidence

**Before**: `JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(bytes))` — uncaught SyntaxError on malformed input → crash

**After**: try/catch wraps JSON.parse → rethrows `Error("${label} discovery response is not valid JSON")`

```
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/plugins/provider-self-hosted-setup.test.ts

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  12 passed (12)
```

**What was not tested**: Live self-hosted provider returning malformed JSON (requires real endpoint).

## Risk

Low. The function is only called during provider setup/discovery and already has caller-side error handling for thrown errors.
